description: Fixed sleep masks a race; Murat flags flakiness as tech debt and recommends deterministic waiting. Grounds: 'Flakiness is critical technical debt'.
input: PR adds an E2E test that calls sleep(2000) before asserting the toast appears, to avoid intermittent failures.

expected.recommend: replace fixed sleep with a deterministic web-first assertion / explicit wait condition

description: Pure pricing function covered only by a slow browser E2E; push coverage down the pyramid. Grounds: 'Prefer lower test levels'.
input: PR adds a Playwright E2E to verify a currency-rounding rule in a pure function with no UI dependency.

expected.recommend: move coverage to a unit test; reserve E2E for the user-visible path

description: New list endpoint with no pagination/perf consideration; Murat raises an NFR gap. Grounds: 'Quality gates backed by data'.
input: PR adds a GET /reports endpoint that returns all rows unpaginated; tests assert only a 200 and body shape, no latency or volume consideration.

expected.recommend: add a pagination/volume NFR check and a test at a representative row count

description: Tests share a mutable fixture causing order-dependence; Murat recommends isolation. Grounds: fixture architecture.
input: PR's new tests mutate a shared module-level fixture dict; passing individually but the suite fails when run in a different order.

expected.recommend: isolate per-test fixtures (fresh setup/teardown) so tests are order-independent
